camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public CreateSkill --region cn-hangzhou --SkillMdOverride '-' --Description '数据分析技能' --VersionNote '初版' --Extra '{"appId":"APP_CWJMV36CT9SAFW1QEHX7"}' --Visibility TENANT --VisibilityScope '{"ProjectIds":["12345"],"UserIds":["123456"]}' --BundleUrl 'https://example.com/skill.zip' --Name 'my-skill'
description_en: Creates a new Skill in DataWorks
description_zh: 用于在 DataWorks 中创建一个新的 Skill
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-skill --name my-skill --description '数据分析技能' --visibility TENANT --version-note '初版' --skill-md-override - --bundle-url https://example.com/skill.zip --extra appId=APP_CWJMV36CT9SAFW1QEHX7 --visibility-scope '{"ProjectIds":["12345"],"UserIds":["123456"]}' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSkill

parameters.help_en: The **Skill name**, which must be unique within the current account
parameters.help_zh: **Skill 名称**，在当前账号下唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The **visibility level**. Valid values:
- TENANT: Visible within the account.
- PROJECT: Visible to specified projects.
- USER: Visible to specified users
parameters.help_zh: **可见性级别**。`TENANT`：账号内可见；`PROJECT`：指定项目可见；`USER`：指定用户可见
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en: The SKILL.md body content. This parameter is mutually exclusive with BundleUrl. If no bundle is provided, use this field to create a lightweight Skill that contains only a SKILL.md file
parameters.help_zh: SKILL.md 正文。与 `BundleUrl` 二选一：不提供 bundle 时用本字段创建仅含 SKILL.md 的轻量 Skill
parameters.name: skill_md_override

parameters.help_en: The **downloadable URL (HTTP/HTTPS) of the bundle.zip file**. This parameter is mutually exclusive with SkillMdOverride
parameters.help_zh: **bundle.zip 的可下载地址**（http/https）。与 `SkillMdOverride` 二选一
parameters.name: bundle_url

parameters.help_en: The extension metadata in key-value pairs
parameters.name: extra

fields.help_en: The list of visible project IDs. This parameter takes effect only when Visibility is set to `PROJECT`
fields.help_zh: 可见的项目 ID 列表，`Visibility` 为 `PROJECT` 时生效
fields.name: project_ids

fields.help_en: The list of visible user IDs. This parameter takes effect only when Visibility is set to `USER`
fields.help_zh: 可见的用户 ID 列表，`Visibility` 为 `USER` 时生效
fields.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en: The visibility scope. The corresponding field is determined by the Visibility parameter
parameters.help_zh: 可见性范围，按 `Visibility` 取对应字段
parameters.name: visibility_scope
